label: Return Rate
description: Percentage of orders that were returned.
formula_plain_english: percentage of orders where transaction_status is a returned value
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN {{transaction_status}} IN {{returned_values}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS return_percent, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM {{fact}}
